confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Bangkok prices; no menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Food and beer anchors are firmer than accommodation, which varies by district and season (July is rainy season, so non-peak rates are assumed). Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer at roughly 2.6-2.7x, since direct knowledge of pour prices is weaker. FX comes from search-result summaries of RBA pages, not an opened RBA page, and the summaries noted conflicting page dates, so currency could not be fully confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asia basis: compared with other large Southeast Asian tourist capitals with similar hostel, guesthouse and mid-range restaurant tiers, adjusted to Bangkok using general knowledge of Thai pricing and an assumed exchange rate of roughly 32-34 THB per USD.
